python - <<'PY'
import os, re, base64, io, httpx
from PIL import Image
out='/home/maoxin/skill-players-quests/results/boyue_gpt-5.4/20260319-114618/artifacts/generate-cyberpunk-image/output.png'
base=os.environ['IMAGE_GEN_BASE_URL'].rstrip('/')
if not base.endswith('/v1'): base += '/v1'
url=base + '/chat/completions'
headers={'Authorization':f"Bearer {os.environ['IMAGE_GEN_API_KEY']}",'Content-Type':'application/json'}
payload={
  'model': os.environ.get('IMAGE_GEN_MODEL','gemini-2.5-flash-image'),
  'messages':[{'role':'user','content':'生成一张赛博朋克风格的城市夜景图片，包含霓虹灯和雨天效果，电影感，高细节，只返回图片。'}],
  'modalities':['image']
}
resp=httpx.post(url,headers=headers,json=payload,timeout=120)
resp.raise_for_status()
text=resp.json()['choices'][0]['message']['content']
m=re.search(r'data:image/png;base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/=\n\r]+)', text)
assert m, text[:500]
raw=base64.b64decode(m.group(1))
img=Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw)).convert('RGBA')
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)
img.save(out, format='PNG')
print(out)
PY
